text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Chestoooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"More!! Dig in your heels!
Bring forth destruction and trample every boundary into dust!!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Then once more!
I shall blow your mind completely!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason being taught how to smash fences
by Tanino Gimlet. The reason dates back two weeks ago...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Celebration: TV appearance confirmed!
I shall increase my exposure and leave quite the impression on everyone~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"According to her, the show she's appearing on is a popular
interactive game variety show. The goal is to clear various games
and aim for the championship."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I figured if I wanted to stand out,
taking the top spot was the way to go!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: We'll get a notification about the game we'll be competing in one week in advance, but—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, before that,
I just happened to overhear what you'd be doing, you see~♪"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Kahahah!
Information warfare is the foundation of battle, is it not?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: It just means preparin' a wee bit early, but it still takes effort nonetheless, y'see!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You have mastered a great power.
You truly are worthy of the Goddess of Victory's blessing in the 'Steeplechase'.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh, feeling confident, are we?
Don't go regretting having 'given salt to your enemy' later, now!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Right, let's keep up this momentum and do more special training!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Look out, look out, No Reason-chan♪
If they snap a photo of your bib number, you lose~♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whaaat!? To think a drone would pursue me all the way out here!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I'm definitely going to survive
this Drone Tag game!!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Take this!!
Shooooooot!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, nice!
Next is... snap your ankles!
Putting a bit more into it might help!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I see, I see! Thanks to Mirako, our prep against "free kicks" is making great progress!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, borrowing her classmates' help,
No Reason racked up special training sessions. And then...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow is finally the real deal...! Everyone,
I truly thank you for all your guidance thus far!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Good luck, No Reason-chan!
We'll be cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm!
The 'Obstacle Race,' 'Drone Tag,'
and the 'Free Kick'—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"We shall conquer every single one of them all together!!
Nyahahaha!!"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
The games you'll be tackling this time are...
'Water Obstacle Course', 'Blindfolded Hide-and-Seek',
and 'Free Throws'~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: No waaaay!?
choice_data_list: This is completely different from what we prepared for...

text_block_list.name: Participant A
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like... there were some rumors going around~.
Something about having a 'steeplechase' this time."

text_block_list.name: Participant B
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh? As if anyone would fall for that, right~?
The show lets us know what we're doing
a week in advance anyway~."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: A false rumor... say what?!
choice_data_list: Didn't you check the notification from the broadcast?
Didn't you check the notification from the broadcast?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Buuut, if it's something I already know anyway, checkin' it would just be a waste of time, wouldn't it?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"However... Nwaaaagh, aaahhhh~~~~!!
What a blunder~~~~!!"
choice_data_list: Even so, let's do everything we can!
What if we looked at it as an opportunity instead?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...I-Indeed, that is true!
Worrying here will accomplish naught...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Then I must do everything humanly possible!!
Trainer! Feast your eyes upon my glory!!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Be as tranquil as the forest—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Attack fiercely like a raging fire!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Take thiiiiiis!!
Furinkazan Shooooot!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
It's innnnn!!
No Reason successfully sinks the free throw!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha! A tactician mustn't drown in their own schemes!
Even if I fail, I'll carve open a new path!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason gave it everything she had.
Despite it being totally improvised,
she managed to pull off a respectable result.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...That's it! My original goal was
to spread my name far and wide! If that's the case—!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
No Reason takes on the water obstacle course!
...Wait, did she just slip right at the start!?
She's clinging to the edge of the stage~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Fngyaaaah?! I'm falling!! Fallingggg~~!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
No Reason managed to crawl back up somehow!
However, as she tries to cross the net bridge—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm tangled up~~~~?!
Somebody, please untangle meeee~~!!

text_block_list.name: Participants
text_block_list.text:
—Her reaction was so good, right?!
—She didn't clear it, but it was hilarious!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: (Mm-hm, splendid reaction♪ We can expect great things from the folks watching at home too, eh?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, her comical "blunder" was aired,
drawing laughter from viewers while leaving
a powerful, lasting impression.
